audio.implementation: original GameMaker OpenAL path through the host provider; Android AudioTrack compatibility through SDL when requested
audio.music_policy: approved volume defaults are installed once on a clean data directory and never overwrite player settings
audio.physical_status: music, effects and audio group 1 physically validated

graphics.backend_policy: inherit firmware selection; use a coherent unversioned ARMHF EGL/GLES provider pair only after proving a versioned-provider conflict
graphics.physical_status: native-resolution menu and gameplay physically validated on Mali-450 and Mali-G31

input.implementation: adapter-owned SDL GameController event and state loop
input.mapping: firmware and PortMaster mappings first, followed by exact observed-controller fallbacks embedded in the generated owner runtime
input.terminal_combo: Select+Start requests the same terminal path as SDL_QUIT

jni.extension_policy: recognized mobile-only services return typed inert success values; unknown behavior is not promoted

language.implementation: launcher selection plus version-specific hook of the exported GameMaker gml_Script_SelectLanguage boundary
language.native_flow: the hook replaces only the language RValue, calls the original function in full, restores the caller argument and releases temporary storage

persistence.policy: all writable owner state is outside the NXExtract runtime seal; legacy saves are imported once and never overwrite newer data

physical_validation.status: on-device-sha-verified; Run_Start and native Portuguese language selection approved

prohibitions: do not reorder or skip the original GameMaker startup
do not package owner APK, extracted runtime, saves or raw logs
do not promote game offsets or language hooks to framework defaults
do not force an EGL/GLES provider without a proven object mismatch
do not claim an untested physical device family
release_boundary: version 1.0.0; exact final artifact physically approved on the Mali-450 baseline and by bounded ArkOS startup/language smoke

terminal.action: after the game has persisted during gameplay, Select+Start or SDL_QUIT ends the process without running unsafe guest audio/GL destructors
